projects.name: R-Shiny Dashboard: U.S. Superstore Sales Analysis
projects.description: An interactive R-Shiny dashboard for analyzing U.S. Superstore sales data from 2014 to 2018. Users can compare sales across business categories and investigate emerging trends.
highlights: Users subset the data by key columns, then view it in data tables and plots or download it.
Each analysis tab renders its visualization when the Display button is clicked.

projects.name: Diabetes Prediction: Logistic Regression
projects.description: A logistic regression classification model built in R with tidymodels to examine relationships between dataset variables and predict diabetes occurrence.
highlights: Prepared and explored the data before model development.
Reviewed classification results to understand variable patterns and the model's predictive output.

projects.name: Data Cleaning & Exploratory Data Analysis
projects.description: Cleaning, transformation and exploration of structured datasets to examine distributions, find inconsistencies and understand patterns ahead of statistical analysis.
highlights: Examined distributions and identified inconsistencies in structured datasets.
Applied data-quality checks to prepare datasets for visualization and further analysis.

projects.name: timeliner
projects.description: A Rust super-timeline builder that merges Linux logs, login records, shell histories and bodyfiles into one de-duplicated UTC timeline tagged by YAML rules.
highlights: 19 default YAML rules tag brute force, SSH from a new IP, sudo to root and more.
Normalizes local-time logs and UTC epoch artifacts into one ordered timeline.

projects.name: evtxkit
projects.description: A from-scratch Rust parser for Windows EVTX event logs with a chunk-parallel JSONL pipeline, CRC verification, damaged-file recovery and Sigma-style field mapping.
highlights: Matches the reference parser on all 4,805 records of 9 public sample logs.
Parses at 250 MiB/s on one thread and 790 MiB/s on 8 threads.

projects.name: binscope
projects.description: A Rust static triage tool for ELF, Mach-O and PE binaries. It reports sections, entropy, imports, tagged strings, capability rules and ssdeep/TLSH fuzzy hashes.
highlights: 34 built-in YAML capability rules, each match reporting its evidence.
ssdeep and TLSH hashes match the reference tools byte for byte.

projects.name: driftlens
projects.description: A Go library and CLI that classifies drift between Git desired state and live Kubernetes objects. It separates pending Git changes from manual edits, hot-patches, conflicts and server defaults.
highlights: Classifies each object as InSync, OutOfSync, Drifted, Missing or Error.
Stable JSON output and exit codes for CI pipelines.

projects.name: paved
projects.description: An internal developer platform core in Go with a Backstage-compatible software catalog and relation graph, a scaffolder with dry-run diffs, and scorecards with team rollups.
highlights: 26 diagnostic codes give line-accurate catalog validation.
Scorecard rules evaluate 34 repository facts, with rollups up the team hierarchy.

projects.name: stridediff
projects.description: Architecture-as-code tooling that computes a STRIDE threat delta between two versions of a model. A gate fails when a new or escalated threat has no recorded mitigation.
highlights: Diff reports added, removed and escalated threats between model versions.
24 tests; the comment embeds a Mermaid data-flow diagram.
